    13  # Eigenspaces of semisimple linear endomorphisms
    14  
    15  This file contains basic results relevant to the study of eigenspaces of semisimple linear
    16  endomorphisms.
    17  
    18  ## Main definitions / results
    19  
    20  * `Module.End.IsFinitelySemisimple.genEigenspace_eq_eigenspace`: for a semisimple endomorphism,
    21    a generalized eigenspace is an eigenspace.
    22  * `Module.End.IsSemisimple.iSup_eigenspace_eq_top`: over an algebraically closed field,
    23    the eigenspaces of a semisimple endomorphism span the whole space.
    24  * `Module.End.IsSemisimple.eq_zero_iff_forall_eigenvalue`: a semisimple endomorphism over
    25    an algebraically closed field is zero iff all eigenvalues are zero.
    26  
    27  -/

    32  
    33  namespace Module.End
    34

    37  lemma apply_eq_of_mem_of_comm_of_isFinitelySemisimple_of_isNil

    39      (hfg : Commute f g) (hss : g.IsFinitelySemisimple) (hnil : IsNilpotent (f - g)) :
    40      g m = μ • m := by

    42    obtain ⟨l, -, hm⟩ := hm

    46    have h₂ : MapsTo (g - algebraMap R (End R M) μ) p p :=
    47      mapsTo_genEigenspace_of_comm (hfg.sub_right <| Algebra.commute_algebraMap_right μ f) μ l
    48    have h₃ : MapsTo (f - g) p p :=
    49      mapsTo_genEigenspace_of_comm (Commute.sub_right rfl hfg) μ l

    12  /-!
    13  # Triangularizable linear endomorphisms
    14  
    15  This file contains basic results relevant to the triangularizability of linear endomorphisms.
    16  
    17  ## Main definitions / results
    18  
    19  * `Module.End.exists_eigenvalue`: in finite dimensions, over an algebraically closed field, every
    20    linear endomorphism has an eigenvalue.
    21  * `Module.End.iSup_genEigenspace_eq_top`: in finite dimensions, over an algebraically
    22    closed field, the generalized eigenspaces of any linear endomorphism span the whole space.
    23  * `Module.End.iSup_genEigenspace_restrict_eq_top`: in finite dimensions, if the
    24    generalized eigenspaces of a linear endomorphism span the whole space then the same is true of
    25    its restriction to any invariant submodule.
    26  
    27  ## References
    28  
    29  * [Sheldon Axler, *Linear Algebra Done Right*][axler2024]
    30  * https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eigenvalues_and_eigenvectors
    31  
    32  ## TODO
    33  
    34  Define triangularizable endomorphisms (e.g., as existence of a maximal chain of invariant subspaces)
    35  and prove that in finite dimensions over a field, this is equivalent to the property that the
    36  generalized eigenspaces span the whole space.
    37  
    38  ## Tags
    39  
    40  eigenspace, eigenvector, eigenvalue, eigen
    41  -/
    42  
    43  public section
    44  
    45  open Set Function Module Module
    46  
    47  variable {K V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    48    {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    49  
    50  namespace Module.End
    51  
    52  theorem exists_hasEigenvalue_of_genEigenspace_eq_top [Nontrivial M] {f : End R M} (k : ℕ∞)
    53      (hf : ⨆ μ, f.genEigenspace μ k = ⊤) :
    54      ∃ μ, f.HasEigenvalue μ := by
    55    suffices ∃ μ, f.HasUnifEigenvalue μ k by
    56      peel this with μ hμ
    57      exact HasUnifEigenvalue.lt zero_lt_one hμ
    58    simp [HasUnifEigenvalue, ← not_forall, ← iSup_eq_bot, hf]
    59  
    60  -- This is Lemma 5.19 of [axler2024], although we are no longer following that proof.
    61  /-- In finite dimensions, over an algebraically closed field, every linear endomorphism has an
    62  eigenvalue. -/
    63  theorem exists_eigenvalue [IsAlgClosed K] [FiniteDimensional K V] [Nontrivial V] (f : End K V) :
    64      ∃ c : K, f.HasEigenvalue c := by
    65    simp_rw [hasEigenvalue_iff_mem_spectrum]
    66    exact spectrum.nonempty_of_isAlgClosed_of_finiteDimensional K f
    67  
    68  noncomputable instance [IsAlgClosed K] [FiniteDimensional K V] [Nontrivial V] (f : End K V) :
    69      Inhabited f.Eigenvalues :=
    70    ⟨⟨f.exists_eigenvalue.choose, f.exists_eigenvalue.choose_spec⟩⟩
    71  
    72  -- Lemma 8.22(c) of [axler2024]
    73  /-- In finite dimensions, over an algebraically closed field, the generalized eigenspaces of any
    74  linear endomorphism span the whole space. -/
    75  theorem iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top [IsAlgClosed K] [FiniteDimensional K V] (f : End K V) :
    76      ⨆ (μ : K), f.maxGenEigenspace μ = ⊤ := by
    77    -- We prove the claim by strong induction on the dimension of the vector space.
    78    suffices ∀ n, finrank K V = n → ⨆ (μ : K), f.maxGenEigenspace μ = ⊤ by exact this _ rfl
    79    intro n h_dim
    80    induction n

    17  /-!
    18  # Eigenvectors and eigenvalues
    19  
    20  This file defines eigenspaces, eigenvalues, and eigenvectors, as well as their generalized
    21  counterparts. We follow Axler's approach [axler2024] because it allows us to derive many properties
    22  without choosing a basis and without using matrices.
    23  
    24  An eigenspace of a linear map `f` for a scalar `μ` is the kernel of the map `(f - μ • id)`. The
    25  nonzero elements of an eigenspace are eigenvectors `x`. They have the property `f x = μ • x`. If
    26  there are eigenvectors for a scalar `μ`, the scalar `μ` is called an eigenvalue.
    27  
    28  There is no consensus in the literature whether `0` is an eigenvector. Our definition of
    29  `HasEigenvector` permits only nonzero vectors. For an eigenvector `x` that may also be `0`, we
    30  write `x ∈ f.eigenspace μ`.
    31  
    32  A generalized eigenspace of a linear map `f` for a natural number `k` and a scalar `μ` is the kernel
    33  of the map `(f - μ • id) ^ k`. The nonzero elements of a generalized eigenspace are generalized
    34  eigenvectors `x`. If there are generalized eigenvectors for a natural number `k` and a scalar `μ`,
    35  the scalar `μ` is called a generalized eigenvalue.
    36  
    37  The fact that the eigenvalues are the roots of the minimal polynomial is proved in
    38  `LinearAlgebra.Eigenspace.Minpoly`.
    39  
    40  The existence of eigenvalues over an algebraically closed field
    41  (and the fact that the generalized eigenspaces then span) is deferred to
    42  `LinearAlgebra.Eigenspace.IsAlgClosed`.
    43  
    44  ## References
    45  
    46  * [Sheldon Axler, *Linear Algebra Done Right*][axler2024]
    47  * https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eigenvalues_and_eigenvectors
    48  
    49  ## Tags

    68  /-- The submodule `genEigenspace f μ k` for a linear map `f`, a scalar `μ`,
    69  and a number `k : ℕ∞` is the kernel of `(f - μ • id) ^ k` if `k` is a natural number,
    70  or the union of all these kernels if `k = ∞`. (`k = ∞` corresponds to Def 8.19 of [axler2024].)
